description: This file contains functions for handling text documents, including metadata extraction and embedding, text extraction, feature generation, chunking, thumbnail creation, and sanitization. It is part of a larger project related to processing various document types and extracting metadata and features.

methods.name: text_meta_extract
methods.description: Extracts metadata from a text document file and maps it to the IsccMeta schema.

methods.name: text_meta_embed
methods.description: Embeds metadata into a copy of the text document, supporting PDF, EPUB, and Word formats.

methods.name: text_extract
methods.description: Extracts plaintext from a text document, raising an error if no text is found.

methods.name: text_features
methods.description: Creates granular similarity hashes (simprints) for the input text, useful for content comparison.

methods.name: text_chunks
methods.description: Generates variable-sized chunks of text for processing.

methods.name: text_name_from_uri
methods.description: Derives a filename-based name from a URI or file path, used as a fallback title.

methods.name: text_thumbnail
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail image for a text document if supported.

methods.name: text_sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes text from untrusted sources by removing scripts, styles, HTML tags, and normalizing whitespace.
